name: Lighting
tagline: Layers of light — ambient, task, accent and decorative
description: Lighting is the finish that decides how every other finish looks. A good scheme layers ambient, task and accent light on separate circuits, keeps colour temperature consistent, and never relies on a single ceiling fixture. Each product here is specified by lumens, beam angle, CRI and colour temperature — not just wattage.

materials.name: Downlight
materials.blurb: Recessed ceiling light — the base layer of most schemes
materials.description: Flush-mounted fixtures that provide general illumination without visual clutter. Space them at roughly the ceiling height apart, and specify 3000 K in homes — 6500 K daylight reads as an office.

materials.name: Spotlight
materials.blurb: Narrow-beam adjustable fitting that picks out one object
materials.description: Aimable fixtures with a tight beam for artwork, a plant or a texture wall. Accent lighting should sit at three to five times the ambient level to actually read as an accent.

materials.name: COB light
materials.blurb: Chip-on-board LED with a crisp, controlled beam
materials.description: A single dense LED chip gives sharper shadows and better beam control than multi-chip fittings. The go-to for accent lighting in premium residential work.

materials.name: Track light
materials.blurb: Fixtures that slide and aim anywhere along a powered rail
materials.description: One circuit, movable heads — ideal when the art will change or the furniture layout is not settled. Standard in galleries, showrooms and open-plan homes.

materials.name: Profile light
materials.blurb: Aluminium channel with a diffused LED line
materials.description: An extruded profile recessed into ceilings, walls or joinery, diffusing the strip into a clean line of light with no visible dots. The detail that makes modern ceilings look designed.

materials.name: LED strip light
materials.blurb: Flexible tape for coves, niches and under-cabinet light
materials.description: The cheapest way to add a layer of light — but only good with the right driver and a diffuser. Specify IP65 in bathrooms and 24 V for runs over three metres to avoid voltage drop.

materials.name: Pendant light
materials.blurb: Suspended fixture over tables, counters and stairwells
materials.description: Both a light source and an object. Hang it 750–900 mm above a dining table, and keep the lamp shielded — a bare bulb at eye level ruins the room it decorates.

specs.Shielding: Avoid glare at seated eye level

materials.name: Chandelier
materials.blurb: The statement fixture — scale it to the room, not the budget
materials.description: A chandelier is architecture as much as lighting. Check the ceiling hook load, the cleaning access and whether the drop clears the door swing before it goes on the drawing.

materials.name: Wall light
materials.blurb: Sconces and up-down fittings that light the vertical plane
materials.description: Lighting walls makes a room feel larger than lighting the floor does. Sconces at 1500–1700 mm work beside beds and along corridors; up-down fittings graze texture beautifully.

materials.name: Table lamp
materials.blurb: Portable pool of light at eye level
materials.description: The layer that makes a living room feel lived in after dark. Needs a socket where the console or side table actually lands — a detail worth fixing at the furniture layout stage.

materials.name: Floor lamp
materials.blurb: Freestanding light for reading corners and dark corners
materials.description: The easiest fix for a room whose lighting was designed before the furniture was chosen. Arc and tripod forms both work; make sure the cable route is not across a walkway.

materials.name: Under-cabinet light
materials.blurb: Task light on the kitchen worktop, where it is actually needed
materials.description: Mounted at the front edge of the wall unit so the light falls on the chopping board and not on the cook's back. The single most useful light in any kitchen.

materials.name: Cove light
materials.blurb: Hidden strip that washes the ceiling with indirect light
materials.description: Concealed in a false-ceiling pocket, bouncing light off the slab for a soft glow with no visible source. Keep the strip 100–150 mm from the ceiling or you will see scallops.

materials.name: Outdoor light
materials.blurb: IP-rated fittings for balconies, façades and entrances
materials.description: Everything outside needs an IP rating and a corrosion-appropriate body — IP65 minimum for rain, and marine-grade finishes near the coast. Warm colour temperatures flatter planting and stone.

materials.name: Garden light
materials.blurb: Bollards, spikes and uplighters for landscape lighting
materials.description: Low-level bollards for paths, spike uplights for trees, and buried fittings for façades. Use low voltage where children and pets are around, and shield every source from the sightline.

materials.name: Sensor light
materials.blurb: Fittings with built-in motion or daylight sensing
materials.description: Self-contained sensor fixtures for wardrobes, staircases, utility rooms and entrances — no separate sensor, no extra wiring. Rechargeable versions retrofit anywhere.
